description: Kill an `fsync_` token. Any build or CI job using it stops being able to sync schemas immediately, and it cannot be restored — mint a new one and update the secret. `confirm` must be the token id exactly. Use the user's explicit authorization for this action and target. Ask if it is missing. Needs workspace:manage.

confirm.description: The exact sync token id for this irreversible action. Supply it only when the user explicitly authorized this action on this target. Otherwise ask for their decision.

name: fillo_revoke_sync_token
title: Revoke a form sync token
